definition: the early part of the day; morning.

definition: a kind of large-bodied, web-footed waterfowl with a long, graceful neck and, typically, pure white feathers; a kind of swan.
example: ಕೊಳವಕ್ಕಿ ಬಿಳಿ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಡಿದು ಆಕಾಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾರಿತು.
example_en: The swan flapped its white wings and flew into the sky.

definition: the early part of a night (or the late evening).
example_en: In the early part of the night, the village lamps were still burning.

definition: to play for fun, recreation.
example_en: The children were playing happily in the garden.

definition: sleeping; asleep.
example_en: The child was lying asleep on the bed.

definition: very little; meagre; nominal; trivial.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಈ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯಲ್ಪ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had very little interest in this matter.

definition: the process of growing or developing; gradual development toward maturity; growth; development.
example_en: The economic growth of the country gradually became visible.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Crops grew abundantly upon the earth.

definition: to doubt - a) to be uncertain in opinion or belief; to be undecided; b) to be inclined to disbelief.
example_en: I doubted what he said.

definition: to advance (vehemently to catch, seize, etc.).
example_en: The hunter advanced vehemently to catch the deer.

definition: the quality or state of being unsaturated; absence of saturation.
example_en: Scientists examined the unsaturation of this compound.

definition: the tree Nothapodytes foetida ( = Mappia foetida) of Ocacinaceae family; fetid holly.
example_en: They use the leaves of the fetid holly tree for medicine.

definition: an ugly-eye.
example: ಆ ಮುದುಕನಿಗೆ ಅೞಿಗಣ್ ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಹಂಗಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People used to mock that old man calling him ugly-eyed.

definition: the plant Drypetes venusta ( = Hemicyclia venusta) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The plant called mūla grows in the forest.

definition: a rectangular wooden box, cabinet, breadth being more than the length.
example_en: She arranged the clothes in the rectangular wooden box.

definition: a division of a district.
example_en: There are many villages in that division of the district.

definition: the state of being open; the uncovered, unhidden condition.
example_en: Light came inside through the opening of the door.

definition: any of various wolflike carnivores (family Hyaenidae), with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry, fed on carrion; a hyena.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕಳ್ತೆಗಿರುಬ ಸತ್ತ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A hyena was eating a dead animal in the forest.

definition: a lord; a master.
example_en: When the master arrived, everyone stood and honored him.

definition: young ears of corn.
example_en: The farmers cut the young ears of corn and brought them home.
